title: Reverse vaccinology and immunoinformatics identify multi-epitope vaccine candidates against molluscum contagiosum virus.
authors: Khalaf, Shahrazad A; Jasim, Musaab M; Jasim, Younus; Naser, Murtada
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用反向疫苗学和免疫信息学预测MCV多表位疫苗候选，涉及蛋白结构预测和分子对接，但对象为病毒蛋白疫苗设计，非蛋白质结构计算核心问题，方法偏应用。
abstract: Molluscum contagiosum virus (MCV) is a human-specific poxvirus responsible for a common contagious skin infection, yet no licensed prophylactic vaccine is available. Therefore, this study aimed to identify potential vaccine candidates against MCV using integrated reverse vaccinology and immunoinformatics approach. Candidate proteins involved in immune evasion, viral entry, and virion assembly were assessed for physicochemical properties, transmembrane topology, antigenicity, allergenicity, and toxicity. Linear B-cell, cytotoxic T-lymphocyte (CTL), and helper T-lymphocyte (HTL) epitopes were predicted and prioritized based on antigenicity, safety, HLA-binding affinity, and worldwide population coverage. The selected epitopes were assembled into a multi-epitope vaccine construct, followed by physicochemical characterization, secondary and tertiary structure prediction, and molecular docking analysis with Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4). Eight candidate proteins were selected for immunoinformatics analysis, of which six were predicted to be antigenic. Five HTL epitopes, five CTL epitopes, and three non-toxic antigenic B-cell epitopes were selected, providing an estimated worldwide population coverage of 80.69%. The final 351-amino acid construct had a predicted molecular weight of 37.48 kDa, an instability index of 33.29, and a hydrophilic GRAVY value of -0.201. AlphaFold 3 produced a structurally organized model, while docking predicted a favorable interaction with TLR4 (score, -190.46) supported by hydrogen bonds, salt bridges, and electrostatic interactions. The vaccine construct exhibited favorable physicochemical properties, broad population coverage, structural stability, and strong interaction with TLR4, suggesting its potential as a prophylactic vaccine candidate. Nevertheless, further in vitro and in vivo experimental validation is required to confirm its safety and protective efficacy.
abstract_zh: 传染性软疣病毒（MCV）是一种人类特异性痘病毒，引起常见的传染性皮肤感染，但目前尚无获许可的预防性疫苗。因此，本研究旨在通过整合反向疫苗学和免疫信息学方法，识别针对MCV的潜在疫苗候选物。涉及免疫逃逸、病毒进入和病毒粒子组装的候选蛋白，评估了其理化性质、跨膜拓扑结构、抗原性、过敏原性和毒性。预测了线性B细胞、细胞毒性T淋巴细胞（CTL）和辅助性T淋巴细胞（HTL）表位，并根据抗原性、安全性、HLA结合亲和力和全球人群覆盖率进行优先排序。选定的表位被组装成多表位疫苗构建体，随后进行理化特性表征、二级和三级结构预测，以及与Toll样受体4（TLR4）的分子对接分析。共选出八种候选蛋白进行免疫信息学分析，其中六种被预测具有抗原性。选择了五个HTL表位、五个CTL表位和三个无毒抗原性B细胞表位，估计全球人群覆盖率为80.69%。最终构建体由351个氨基酸组成，预测分子量为37.48 kDa，不稳定指数为33.29，亲水性GRAVY值为-0.201。AlphaFold 3生成了结构有序的模型，而对接预测了与TLR4的有利相互作用（得分，-190.46），并由氢键、盐桥和静电相互作用支持。该疫苗构建体表现出良好的理化性质、广泛的人群覆盖率、结构稳定性以及与TLR4的强相互作用，表明其作为预防性疫苗候选物的潜力。尽管如此，仍需进一步的体外和体内实验验证以确认其安全性和保护效力。
